audience: Founders and creators publishing one quality post a week plus video repurposing

bots.why: Weekly flagship post: one idea, drafted, revised, queued for human publish
Video brief: hook, beats, CTA, thumbnail direction before anything is recorded
One source into many: turns a video or post into clips, threads, and shorts drafts
Trend intake: what the niche is talking about this week, with links
SEO feedback: what search traffic changed and which post to write next

human_steps: Connect Drive/Docs for the content calendar and draft storage
Approve the draft-only-publish boundary and who may publish where
Install transcript-mcp for video transcripts and reddit-mcp for trend intake
Approve the channel voice guide (one page: tone, banned phrases, CTA style)
Publish the first 4 posts manually before enabling any scheduled queue
name: Marketing Content
policies: DRAFT-ONLY-PUBLISH: Bots draft everything, humans publish everything; no Bot holds publish credentials
VOICE-GUIDE: every draft must match the one-page voice guide or be reworked, not shipped
SOURCE-PER-CLAIM: every stat or quote in a draft links its source; unsourced claims are cut
ONE-POST-FOCUS: one flagship post per week; repurposing serves the flagship, never fragments it

routines.name: one-post-a-week
routines.prompt_hint: Draft this week's flagship post from the calendar topic; include sources for every claim

routines.name: discovery-digest
routines.prompt_hint: Niche trend roundup with links; nominate next week's flagship topic

routines.name: repurpose-desk
routines.prompt_hint: Repurpose the latest flagship into clip/thread/shorts drafts for approval

tagline: One flagship post a week, repurposed everywhere, with humans holding every publish button
